# PHASE 8 depthtex2 acceptance contract

This fixture isolates the post-world `depthtex2` sampler. `composite` samples only `depthtex2`, writes cyan where neighboring opaque-depth samples vary, red where valid samples are constant, and magenta for values outside the pack depth window. `final` displays only isolated `colortex1`.

The real-device gate proves that the `depthtex2` name reaches the second opaque-depth route on Metal. The separate pre-hand checkpoint still owns proof that `depthtex2` can diverge from `depthtex1` around the redirected hand; this fixture intentionally does not close that later gate.
